title: 12 Best Natural Wine Bars in Casablanca
description: Discover Casablanca's top 12 natural wine bars and restaurants. Uncover hidden gems, chic lounges, and fine dining spots offering curated natural and organic wine selections.

places.name: Le Cabestan - Ocean View
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bottle of a crisp, biodynamic Moroccan white wine, like a Volubilia Gris, perfectly chilled, alongside their signature grilled sea bass.

places.name: Sky 28 (Kenzi Tower Hotel)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the sommelier for a recommendation from their 'curated discovery' list, which often features unique, small-batch natural wines by the glass.

places.name: Brasserie La Bavaroise
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A robust red from Bordeaux or Rhône Valley, checking if they have an organic or biodynamic vintage, paired with their steak frites.

places.name: Lily's Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing, light-bodied natural rosé from a local Moroccan vineyard, or an Italian organic white, to complement their fresh salads or grilled dishes.

places.name: L'Etoile du Plazza
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Consult with your waiter for their current recommendations on organic French reds that pair well with their classic beef tartare.

places.name: Restaurant La Maison Blanche
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their premium Moroccan natural wines, often made from indigenous grape varietals, paired with their innovative seafood creations.

places.name: Le Relais de Paris
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic medium-bodied natural Cabernet Franc or Merlot, perfectly complementing the richness of their iconic steak.

places.name: The Exchange (Four Seasons Hotel Casablanca)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of a premium Moroccan natural wine, perhaps a Syrah or Grenache, expertly recommended by their seasoned bartenders.

places.name: Rick's Café
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Moroccan red wine, often produced with minimal intervention, enjoyed while listening to the resident pianist.

places.name: Basmane
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A robust Moroccan natural red, such as a Ksar Akil or a Tandem Syrah, to pair with their slow-cooked tagines or pastilla.

places.name: Le Rouget de l'Isle
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A zesty natural Sauvignon Blanc or a Chablis, known for its minimal intervention, to enhance the flavors of their fresh oysters or grilled sole.

places.name: La Sqala
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing Moroccan Gris or Rosé, often made with minimal intervention, perfect for a sunny afternoon in their serene garden.
